newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer, gains pared near close.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer, gains pared near close.

text.p: COMEX copper ended slightly firmer in a shortened, pre-holiday session with most of the day's slim gains pared near the close.
A hike in LME stocks Tuesday was in line with market expectations and had no effect. Stocks rose 3,950 tonnes to 121,400 tonnes.
Most active March COMEX went out 0.30 cent higher at 98.85 cents per pound, traded 99.70 to 98.45 cents. Spot December also settled 0.30 cent firmer at 101.60 cents.
Volume was thin at an estimated 5,500 lots, compared to Monday's official 4,647 lots.
Floor traders said activity was featureless but steady.
The LME cash to three months premium, or backwardation, remained firm at $99/$104.
Analysts expected the premium to keep futures prices firm well into January where there is some tightness in the LME contract for that month.
COMEX closed an hour earlier at 1300 EST. The exchange is shut Wednesday for Christmas Day and reopens Thursday.
LME also shut early and will be closed Wednesday and Thursday, reopening Friday when there will be no regular stock report.
